description: Welcome to the Anime Club @ UCI! ( A.K.A. Cal Animage Epsilon ) We are a social hobby slash interest club that interacts with all things anime! We are home to Anteaters of boundless interests, including artists, cosplayers, con-goers, scanlators, and amatuer musicians. We are also home to enjoyers of manga, manhwa, visual novels, VTubers, and anime-related video plus tabletop games. If you have an anime-related interest or endeavor, consider us an ally!
